name: Jasmine Rice
siboNotes: Well-tolerated starchy carbohydrate that's easy to digest and can help provide safe energy for SIBO patients.
preparationTips: Rinse thoroughly before cooking to remove excess starch
Use 1:1.5 rice to water ratio for fluffy texture
Let rest 5 minutes after cooking before fluffing
Store cooked rice in refrigerator up to 4 days
nutritionalHighlights: Good source of carbohydrates for energy
